body: Medium: durable-decisions still instructs an FO-rendered delegated close to quote the Captain directive in reason, contradicting the retired provenance surface; amend the binding ruling while preserving renderer identity and point to the canonical gate-resolution contract.

Medium: capability preflight checks required gate flags but accepts a candidate that still exposes the retired --directive surface; reject that candidate and prescribe an actionable binary refresh or selected fresh build.
Medium: add a live later-grant harness proving that an open presented gate accepts conn granted in a later turn and then closes.
Medium: introduce a semantic delegated-reason schema so FO evidence, route meaning, and Captain grant provenance are separately machine-verifiable.
Low: pin a fixed vocabulary for the present-gate decision ask instead of accepting semantic wording.
Low: retain gate validate compatibility for legacy prototype records that carry the retired directive or adoption-note fields.
Low: reorder actor validation so unsupported actor errors are emitted before other decision argument errors.
Low: add a serializer indentation probe for gate frontmatter even though the canonical emitter currently preserves the asserted shape.

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: Cycle 31 assigns supported-host conn proof to the existing initial-grant journeys and deterministic no-conn controls, and no supported later-grant failure is observed; promotes-when: an actual supported conversation supplies a later grant and the open gate remains stuck or acts early, or an already-approved existing interaction runner can exercise the transition without new live or harness scope

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the acceptance criteria require a nonblank FO evidence judgment and the existing route mappings preserve decision meaning, while chat grant text is neither authenticated nor retained; promotes-when: a supported delegated close cannot express the required evidence or route meaning with the existing reason field, or durable state misrepresents chat grant text as authenticated authority

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the presenter contract owns a semantic decision ask and no supported compliant review is rejected by the current oracle; promotes-when: a supported review carrying the required semantic decision ask is rejected by the oracle

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: v1 is unreleased and prototype-format compatibility and migration are explicitly outside the contract; promotes-when: a released v1 record requires supported legacy validation or migration

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: error ordering is polish because the supported missing and unsupported actor routes already return distinct exact actionable errors; promotes-when: ordering or wording misleads a supported operator into the wrong remediation route

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the canonical emitter and existing round-trip oracle preserve the supported frontmatter result with no observed false result; promotes-when: the emitter changes indentation or the existing oracle returns a false result

reason: triage: 2 material findings fixed at 537f443e; 6 declined with explicit promotion conditions
